newsitem.title: USA: Most US stock index futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Most US stock index futures end sharply lower.

text.p: Feb 20 - Most U.S. stock index futures ended sharply lower, with March S&Ps sinking back towards the 800.00 level. Some traders are looking for a break to 780.00. They said the selloff in key tech stocks was leading S&Ps and Nasdaq 100s lower. The bulk of the day's losses occurred in the latter half of the day.
